messages.content: Write a complete, production-quality TypeScript implementation of a generic LRU cache class. Requirements: generic key/value types, configurable max size, optional per-entry TTL with lazy expiration, O(1) get/set/delete using a doubly-linked list plus a Map, a peek method that does not affect recency, a stats getter (hits, misses, evictions), and full JSDoc comments on every public member. After the implementation, write a comprehensive suite of unit tests using Vitest covering eviction order, TTL expiry, stats accuracy, and edge cases. Finally, explain the key design decisions in a short paragraph.
